question: Which V2O5 film thicknesses were tested electrochemically, how many ALD cycles gave the thicker film, and did the potential shifts differ between them?
expect: ~80 nm (1000 ALD cycles, Fig. 3 caption p4.L61) and ~40 nm; similar ΔEeq(avg) shifts (~40 mV) for both, owing to similar locked-in strains (p4.L40-44)
rendered:
According to the document, two V2O5 film thicknesses were tested electrochemically: ∼80 nm and ∼40 nm. The thicker film, ∼80 nm, was achieved with 1000 ALD cycles. The thinner film, ∼40 nm, was achieved with an unspecified number of ALD cycles, but it is mentioned that the thickness dependence of strain in V2O5 coatings is shown in Figure 1c.

The potential shifts between the two film thicknesses are not explicitly compared in the text. However, it is mentioned that similar shifts in values of ΔEeq(avg) were observed for both ∼80 nm and ∼40 nm V2O5 films (see Supporting Information, Figure S15). This suggests that the potential shifts did not differ significantly between the two film thicknesses.
